name: Thi Nai bridge
kicker: The white span across the lagoon
summary: White sea bridge across the lagoon: cross the span in about 30 minutes, free, on the road to the peninsula. The span is 2,477.3 m in 54 sections, on a road of more than 7 km. Stop for the afternoon light, or for the lamps after dark.
getThere: The lagoon is 8 km northeast, on the road to the peninsula.
heroCaption: The span by day, with mangrove and water

notice.title: The span is 2,477.3 m
notice.body: The length is 2,477.3 m, in 54 sections, on a road of more than 7 km that also has five shorter bridges. The road is free. The lamps come on after dark.

gettingThere: The bridge is in Phường Quy Nhơn, on the road from the city to Nhơn Hội. The lagoon sits 8 km northeast. The span is 2,477.3 m with 54 sections, on a road of more than 7 km.

legs.heading: From the city beach
legs.body: By road toward the peninsula. The lagoon is 8 km northeast.

hours: 7:00–18:00 is the listed hour. The lamps are on after dark, and the road stays open.
closed: No weekly closing day is listed.
